tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
AS PER THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THE TENDER DOCUMENTS

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Details of bidder including name, address, details of contact, such as telephone numbers, mobile numbers, email or fax, testimonials and proof of experience as required
If the bidder has been a Rate Contract holder of this institute performance certificate issued by our institute should be uploaded without fail. Failing which your tender may be rejected.
Latest Income Tax Assessment copy of Tenderer

Notarized copies of ownership of vehicles RC book or notarized copies of lease agreements shall be produced along with the bid. The notarized copies of RC book to provide proof of date of manufacture of the vehicles is to be produced.
The Bidder can be Individuals/firms/partnerships/consortiums/ company incorporated under the Companies Act, 1956.
The Bidder shall have at least 3years of experience in Collection, Transportation and Disposal of wastes.
